title.en: Time and the days of the week

recall.uz: Vaqt toʻxtamay oʻtadi. Boʻlib oʻtgan voqealar — oʻtmish, hali boʻlmaganlari — kelajak, biz esa bugun yashaymiz. Bir haftada yetti kun bor. Dushanba, seshanba, chorshanba, payshanba, juma — ish kunlari. Shanba va yakshanba — dam olish kunlari.
recall.ru: Время идёт без остановки. Прошедшие события — прошлое, ещё не наступившие — будущее, а мы живём сегодня. В неделе семь дней. Понедельник, вторник, среда, четверг, пятница — рабочие дни. Суббота и воскресенье — выходные.
recall.en: Time flows without stopping. Past events are the past, events not yet happened are the future, and we live today. A week has seven days. Monday to Friday are workdays. Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.

prompt.en: Put time in the right order!

hint.uz: Avval oʻtmish, keyin bugun, soʻng kelajak.
hint.ru: Сначала прошлое, потом сегодня, затем будущее.
hint.en: First the past, then today, then the future.

explanation.uz: Vaqt oʻtmishdan bugunga, bugundan kelajakka oqadi.
explanation.ru: Время течёт из прошлого в сегодня, из сегодня в будущее.
explanation.en: Time flows from the past to today, and from today to the future.

prompt.en: What is a past event called?

hint.en: What happened before is the past.

explanation.uz: Boʻlib oʻtgan voqealar oʻtmish deyiladi. Hali boʻlmaganlari — kelajak.
explanation.ru: Прошедшие события называют прошлым. Ещё не наступившие — будущим.
explanation.en: Past events are called the past. Events not yet happened are the future.

prompt.uz: Kunlarni ish va dam olish kunlariga ajrat!
prompt.ru: Разложи дни на рабочие и выходные!
prompt.en: Sort the days into workdays and weekend!

hint.uz: Dushanba va juma — ish kuni; shanba va yakshanba — dam olish.
hint.ru: Понедельник и пятница — рабочие; суббота и воскресенье — выходные.
hint.en: Monday and Friday are workdays; Saturday and Sunday are weekend.

explanation.uz: Dushanba–juma ish kunlari. Shanba va yakshanba dam olish kunlari.
explanation.ru: Понедельник–пятница — рабочие дни. Суббота и воскресенье — выходные.
explanation.en: Monday–Friday are workdays. Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.

hint.en: It starts on Monday and goes to Friday.

explanation.uz: Ish kunlari tartibi: dushanba, seshanba, chorshanba, payshanba, juma.
explanation.ru: Порядок рабочих дней: понедельник, вторник, среда, четверг, пятница.
explanation.en: Workday order: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday.

prompt.en: How many days are in a week?

hint.uz: Dushanba — birinchi kun, undan keyingisi ikkinchi.
hint.en: Monday is the first day; the next is the second.

hint.uz: Maktabga bormaydigan kunlar — shanba va yakshanba.
hint.ru: Дни без школы — суббота и воскресенье.
hint.en: The no-school days are Saturday and Sunday.

explanation.uz: Shanba va yakshanba dam olish kunlari. Qolganlari — ish kunlari.
explanation.ru: Суббота и воскресенье — выходные. Остальные — рабочие.
explanation.en: Saturday and Sunday are the weekend. The rest are workdays.

prompt.en: Grandpa's childhood — which time is it?

explanation.uz: Bobongning bolaligi oʻtmishda boʻlgan. U allaqachon oʻtib ketgan.
explanation.ru: Детство дедушки было в прошлом. Оно уже прошло.
explanation.en: Grandpa's childhood was in the past. It has already passed.

hint.ru: Будущее — то, что ещё не наступило.
hint.en: The future is what has not happened yet.

explanation.uz: Kelajak — hali kelmagan zamon. Uni raketa va yangi shaharlar bilan tasavvur qilamiz.
explanation.ru: Будущее — время, которое ещё не наступило. Его представляют ракетой и новыми городами.
explanation.en: The future is time that has not come yet. We imagine it with rockets and new cities.

prompt.uz: Bir haftada nechta dam olish kuni bor?
prompt.en: How many weekend days are in a week?

explanation.uz: Bir haftada ikkita dam olish kuni bor: shanba va yakshanba.
explanation.ru: В неделе два выходных: суббота и воскресенье.
explanation.en: A week has two weekend days: Saturday and Sunday.
